dropped.item: The specific end-of-day routine: straightening the lab stools, checking the taps, and wiping down a bench that was already clean. The edit reduces this to generic 'cleaning up'.
The narrator had thought of retirement only as a date on the calendar and had not thought about how they would actually leave the room.
Some lessons went beautifully, while others the narrator spent the drive home figuring out how to teach again.
There were students the narrator still wondered about.
A few students' questions changed how the narrator explained something for the next twenty years.
The narrator was ready to go but still took their time. The edit keeps the time-taking but loses the tension of being ready yet lingering.

changed.item: The original says the narrator had NOT given much thought to how they would leave. The edit says the narrator 'had carefully prepared for this day', which reverses the meaning.
Reflection on individual lessons that went well or needed reteaching becomes 'good years and bad years', which changes the unit and substance of the reflection.
'I was ready to go' becomes 'I was finally leaving', repeated twice. This suggests relief or impatience rather than readiness mixed with reluctance.

added.item: The narrator had carefully prepared for the day.
Uncertainty about going out 'with a bang or with a whimper'.
The narrator had good years and bad years.
Many memorable experiences with students, both good and bad.
Emphasis on 'finally' leaving, implying long-awaited departure.

invented_specifics: I had carefully prepared for this day
whether with a bang or with a whimper
I had had good years and I had had bad years
